description: This file defines the AssetManagerFileSystem class which provides an implementation of a read-only file system interface using Android's AAssetManager. It facilitates access to assets bundled within an Android APK, exposing methods for file operations such as existence checks, size retrieval, and directory listing, but not modification.

classes.name: AssetManagerFileSystem
classes.description: A class implementing a read-only file system backed by Android's AAssetManager, allowing access to APK assets within TensorFlow
